# 987NES ($NES)

> 987NES is a Swiss memecoin built on the Solana blockchain, born in Fribourg, Switzerland, on October 16, 2025. Ticker: $NES. Fixed supply of 987,654,321 tokens. 0% tax. Liquidity pool locked (TeamFinance). Team doxxed (Dom, Paco, Luis, Flavien). Team allocation (20%) locked until October 16, 2027 (Streamflow). Distribution: 70% market, 20% founders (locked), 10% marketing. Mascot: DZÔ, the blue monster ("Not recycled. Not a frog. Not a dog. Not a clown.").

## Key facts
- Contract address (Solana): DPQdhJF7MtwjFKwzg8QkWQcBF8aoJHDpA4gpCYvuFu4t
- Chain: Solana. Buy on Raydium or Jupiter with a Phantom wallet.
- Name: NineEightSeven, a deliberately incomplete countdown. Motto: "Execution over promise."
- In-house tools: 987Buy (Telegram transaction alerts), 987News (crypto news digest with AI summaries).
- Languages: English, French, Spanish (same page, language switcher).
